transformation: Lossless remux with movie_timescale 48000 and faststart; avcC reserved bits normalized. No audio/video re-encoding.
referencePolicy: Persisted material, captions, cue times and attempts retain the official original source identity. The playback file has its own different hash; this manifest is not a claim that it is the original file.
limitation: The reporting Android browser rejected the verified Blob with an AAC-specific native error. A direct transport result must be confirmed on that device; desktop direct tests are separate evidence.

transport.initialVerification: Full response SHA-256, exact final same-origin URL, no redirect, video/mp4 MIME.
transport.nativeIntegrityBoundary: Native URL playback may make a separate request. Its bytes are not hashed by HTMLVideo or checked with SRI. It relies on the published same-origin full-hash-named resource remaining immutable.
